description: Compare 2-15 domains to find which ones share an operator or infrastructure. Returns a Markdown summary and structured output with clusters, pairwise scores and the shared signals behind them. Each entry is a bare hostname such as 'example.com', with no scheme, path or port. Cost: 1 credit for each domain that has not been analyzed recently, plus 1 for the correlation. The charge is refunded if the call fails or runs out of time. The call usually answers within about half a minute. The correlation itself is cut off after 24 seconds. If it runs out of time, use fewer domains or the REST API (POST /correlate), which runs in the background.
name: correlate_domains
